role: Bounded timeline diagnosis on already-used training scenes, not another performance benchmark or parameter search
profile_assignment: Preserve original training assignment: episode index divisible by 4 is nominal; other indices are stress. Six nominal and eighteen stress scenes per context.
hypothesis_to_diagnose: Separating operator actions is insufficient. Determine whether sampled collisions occur after clearance-only neutral requests or independent assistance, or without either event; do not assume transport delay explains every collision.
capture: Original observation/action/feedback times, first clearance-only STOP and first assistance, bounded ten-transition windows, displacement measured from simulated world coordinates after each event, applied-output counts to natural end and terminal observation. Diagnostic truth is never policy input.
aggregates: Timeline category counts, first-assistance reasons and latency strata only. Individual outcomes retained for audit; no new task-success or collision-rate ranking/selection.
comparison_limit: Fixed snapshot and rules differ as whole controllers. No counterfactual physics intervention or historical evolving-Q replay; temporal precedence does not establish cause or population failure attribution.
next_step_constraint: Do not train again from these counts alone. Inspect evidence/representation and formulate a new observation-based avoidance hypothesis with deterministic fault tests and a new frozen protocol first. Preserve R2 current, inertia, clearance, ACK and watchdog guards.
